headline: Acquisitions lift sales; margin dips and outlook trimmed
summary_short: Lowe's Q3 sales rose 9.3% to $22.8B with comparable sales up 1.8%; diluted EPS was $2.98 and adjusted EPS $3.10, up 1.3%. FY26 adjusted EPS is now expected at about $12.25.
summary_long: Total sales were $22.8B versus $20.8B; comparable sales rose 1.8%, with online sales up 17.4% and solid Pro and home services results. Gross margin fell to 32.95% from 34.19%. Net earnings were $1.7B. FY26 outlook: sales about $92.5B (from $92.0B), comps about +0.5% (from flat), adjusted operating margin about 11.5% (from 11.6%), adjusted EPS about $12.25, capex up to $2.5B.
confidence_notes: EPS y/y and gross margin y/y deltas are computed from the release's current and prior-year values ($2.98 vs $2.88; 32.95% vs 34.19%). The 9.3% sales growth includes the acquired FBM and ADG businesses, which the release implies via amortization of acquisition intangibles but does not quantify as a growth driver. Adjusted EPS excludes $96M pre-tax acquisition intangible amortization.

drivers.explanation: Driven by a 17.4% increase in online sales plus solid performance in Pro and home services sales; sixth consecutive quarter of positive comps.
Not explained in the release; cost of sales rose to 67.05% of sales from 65.81%.
Outlook was updated for first-three-quarter results, current demand trends and cost pressures across the business: sales and comps were raised, margins trimmed.
